snip.t: Tuberoinfundibular: Dopamine inhibits prolactin release from the pituitary — Hyperprolactinaemia (galactorrhoea, menstrual disturbance, sexual dysfunction)
Other effects: hyperprolactinaemia, QT prolongation, neuroleptic malignant syndrome (fever, rigidity, altered consciousness, raised creatine kinase), tardive dyskinesia with long use.
Anovulation: clomiphene or letrozole, metformin in PCOS, gonadotrophins, and cabergoline for hyperprolactinaemia.
snip.s: Integrated case paper: Medicine, Surgery, Gynaecology and Paediatrics (160 marks

snip.t: Secondary amenorrhoea from PCOS, thyroid disease, hyperprolactinaemia, premature ovarian failure, stress or weight change.

Menstrual / reproductive: Cycle regularity, amenorrhoea, galactorrhoea, infertility, libido — Hyperprolactinaemia (prolactinoma) suppresses GnRH → oligomenorrhoea/amenorrhoea; galactorrhoea from prolactin excess.
| Prolactinoma | Galactorrhoea, amenorrhoea, infertility, mild headache | Isolated hyperprolactinaemia; normal ACTH/cortisol; MRI shows sellar lesion without cavernous sinus invasion. |
D2 blockade removes this inhibition and may cause hyperprolactinaemia, galactorrhoea, amenorrhoea, sexual dysfunction and reduced bone density over time.
